archetypes.name: dyn-ci-merge-policy
archetypes.rationale: Changed PR checks bucket policy and merge-loop CI_NOT_READY handling need consistency review.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed gh.py check parsing and ship.py merge-loop guard for consistency with the resolved CI policy. Verify skipped, cancelled, neutral, and unknown JSON buckets are mergeable while fail and pending still block. Check that REVIEW_REQUIRED remains routed to user input before the CI-not-ready stall guard. Pay close attention to races where diagnostics show no blockers after merge_pr returned CI_NOT_READY. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
